title: Attention Architecture Mini Benchmark
paperText:
# Abstract
We propose a sequence transduction model based entirely on attention.
# Problem
Recurrent models prevent parallelization because sequence positions are processed sequentially.
# Method
The model uses multi-head self-attention and position-wise feed-forward networks. Attention(Q,K,V)=softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k))V.
# Experiments
We evaluate on WMT 2014 English-to-German translation against recurrent and convolutional baselines.
# Results
The model reaches 28.4 BLEU and trains for 12 hours.
# Conclusion
The contribution is a parallel architecture without recurrence.
Figure 1 shows the model architecture. Table 1 reports translation results.
